_comment: Fixed roster fetched every Monday. type: venue | aggregator. cats: which categories the page expects from it. Add a line here when something was missed. Galleries: the PAC agenda search page lists every member event; fetch it first, then the gallery pages for vernissage dates and next shows. NOTE (2026-10-26): WebFetch only accepts URLs that a WebSearch has surfaced in the same session; search '<venue> programme <mois> 2026' first, then fetch. musees.marseille.fr, unidivers.fr and lupop.fr refuse fetching. NOTE (2026-11-09): what works for fetching is a WebSearch with allowed_domains set to the site's own domain, then WebFetch of a URL that search returned; URLs taken from this file or from inside a fetched page are usually refused. A run has about 200 web searches in total, shared by all subagents: give each agent a share (about 30) and do the completeness sweep first.
